notes: Smoother zoom, popout menus, blue force tracker

Zooming into cities no longer stalls: building alignment is now baked into the map data, a city's streets are prepared between gestures (or ahead of time as you close in) instead of in the middle of a zoom, and big cities draw from cached tiles from mid zoom, roughly halving frame time there
On wider screens the side menus open as a popout beside the button you pressed instead of the panel at the bottom. Units, cities and other things you tap on the map still open at the bottom
In the drone and FLIR views a camera button under Lase switches between FLIR white hot, FLIR black hot, night vision, daylight TV and colour, without going into Settings
Friendly units show in blue boxes labelled by the blue force tracker in the 3D drone view and the zoomed FLIR map, next to the red boxes on known enemy

Impacts and explosions now throw a dust burst, leave a scorch mark and a smoke plume that rises and drifts for up to half a minute in 3D, and explosions on the map leave smoke that hangs for several seconds
The troops-in-contact alert and other alerts now sit to the left of the right-hand map buttons instead of on top of them
